title: IELTS Academic Vol 7 - Reading Test 1 - Passage 2
passageHtml:
READING PASSAGE 2

Drawing Lessons from History

Numerous ancient civilisations collapsed or disappeared... We are drawn to their magnificent and haunting beauty, as well as the enigmas they present. These builders vanished, abandoning the remarkable structures they had painstakingly constructed.

For a long time, it has been suspected... substantiated by discoveries made in recent decades by archaeologists, climatologists, historians, palaeontologists, and palynologists.

Historical collapses generally followed similar patterns resembling variations on a theme. However, this metaphor proves inaccurate for many past societies... not all past societies followed this trajectory uniformly.

Currently, many individuals believe that environmental problems eclipse other global threats. These environmental problems encompass the same eight factors... plus four new ones: ...accumulation of toxic chemicals. However, the seriousness of these modern environmental dilemmas is vigorously debated.

It would be naive to assume that studying the past will yield straightforward answers directly applicable to today’s world. At the same time... our potent technology (i.e. its unintended destructive effects)... only if we carefully contemplate its lessons.
